stories.title: BigBear Microsoft 365 phishing service bypassed MFA at 258 organizations
stories.summary: A phishing-as-a-service framework called BigBear 2.0 has been used to bypass multi-factor authentication at 258 organizations and steal more than 5,000 Microsoft 365 credentials.

stories.title: Raymond Depardon revisits photojournalist past at Visa Pour l'Image festival

entries.title: The leak didn't move the date
entries.body: Rockstar ran its Netflix Extended Look on 27 August as planned, and 19 November still stands. Take-Two, meanwhile, has served DMCA subpoenas on Microsoft, Discord, X and Google chasing the handle CyberLeek.
